name: frameback
description: Local review tool for agentic video editing: anchor comments to frames, regions, ranges and timeline entities; your AI editing agent picks them up live.
author: Guillermo Becerra (GBO)

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web "tsx watch src/cli/index.ts open examples/demo/edit/final_demo_v1.mp4 --no-open --dev" "vite --config web/vite.config.ts"
scripts.build: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && npm run build:web && npm run build:node
scripts.demo: node -e "require('fs').existsSync('dist/cli/index.js')||process.exit(1)" || npm run build; npm run demo:make && node dist/cli/index.js open examples/demo/edit/final_demo_v1.mp4
